Snowy brings interactive snow to window edges, desktop widgets, Spotlight, and a bottom-positioned Dock.

- Fixes an issue where the ChatGPT desktop companion overlay could block snow from falling on the right side of the screen.
- **Open Snowy…** brings up Wallpapers, Decorations, and a Guide with a replayable walkthrough.
- Import wallpapers in batches and apply them to one or all displays. Two original winter wallpapers are included.
- Pick a pixel-art preset or build a custom scene. Props catch snow, snap to the desktop edge or Dock, and can slide when swept.
- Hang string lights from display edges, widgets, or supported Finder icons. Lights respond to wind and cursor crossings. Finder icon anchors use optional Accessibility access.

Open the DMG and drag **Snowy.app** onto **Applications**. If you have 0.9.1 or earlier, quit it and replace it with this copy once. Going forward, a blue **Update** item in the snowflake menu appears for newer compatible releases. Click it to download, install, and reopen Snowy.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later.

SHA-256 checksums are attached beside the DMG and ZIP files. Source build and usage instructions are in the README.

This beta uses local code signing. If macOS blocks the copy you downloaded here, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** after trying to open it. If Finder icon anchors stop following after an update, check Snowy’s Accessibility permission.
